title: Installed Wright: common and saved process interfaces
summary: Genuine local wheel installation, cached dependencies, copied isolated engineering workspace; no model/compiler or engineering dispatch.

manualSteps.label: Open installed Wright
manualSteps.instruction: Open the installed native Wright home page, then the isolated proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows, Workflow files, Open workflow, then choose the saved wheel workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use working view
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process and open the second recorded run link.

manualSteps.label: Reuse interface
manualSteps.instruction: Click Create or choose interface, choose the saved focus-wheel interface and current revision, then Open saved interface.

manualSteps.label: Reload
manualSteps.instruction: Reload the working tab and inspect the same waiting review. Leave the review unanswered.
